notes.title: Story Objectives Finalized
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

Maenovan's story events, and objectives have been finalized and fully implimented. The temporary user interface is next on the chopping block. It will be redesigned for simplicity and minimalism to improve immersion. The list of adjustments and finishing touches is dwindling, and the finish line is coming quickly. The audio system is being wrapped up as well, and we look forward to creating some game trailers/gameplay sneak peeks soon. For right now, below are two screenshots taken during testing of the new AI/Enemy. The interface shown is the temporary one, and will soon be replaced. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38228532/e289032afef7fd0b9cf40e51aef4f2476ba0b24d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38228532/fc2f51a92ef82aea3906c941940b290f08b0aae2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38228532/a6b25561a34ecb5b9f7af33b3266063ca34a54ab.png[/img]
Sometime in the near future, perhaps in video format, we will publish a lore/story guide. Even without an engrossing story, the game is being designed to be played by those who care about gameplay and mechanics. It's just plain fun (maybe stressful and chaotic) with friends! The current story and difficulty system allows for varying gameplay, and multiple game endings for varying gameplay with others.

Just as a reminder, if you would like to be involved in the progress and give your input please join our discord server, or leave a comment here.

https://discord.com/invite/Uc4Kzv4pWs

Talk soon!
Zero

notes.title: Progress & More
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

Maenovan has continued its progression over the past few months. Current final efforts to complete gameplay and story elements will be shortly followed by some extensive testing and player-developer interaction. If you would like to be part of this interaction, please join the Discord server linked below. More information about release date, pricing, as well as more screenshots and a trailer will follow in the near future. The current anticipated release date is before the end of 2025

notes.title: Visions of Maenovan
notes.notes:
Greetings!

My vision of Maenovan has changed over the last couple of years. The original game has changed a lot since it's inception, and has shifted genres completely. More details will be coming out soon, including storyline, setting, and gameplay details. For now though, it's essential that I communicate my intentions for a release [i]this year[/i]. The game will open sometime over the next couple of months for private testing, and then public release shortly after. 

-Zero
